title: Library Baseline Profiles and SDK Capstone Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies library baseline profiles and sdk capstone?
options: Ship a minimal compatible SDK and prove the exact artifact through independent consumers, critical-journey profiles, hostile hosts, and operational documentation.
questions.answer: Ship a minimal compatible SDK and prove the exact artifact through independent consumers, critical-journey profiles, hostile hosts, and operational documentation.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A library Baseline Profile forces all consuming apps to compile every method in the AAR.
questions.explanation: Generating a Baseline Profile by calling every public API can bloat compilation and teaches nothing about an actual consumer critical journey.

questions.prompt: Where is a library Baseline Profile ultimately used?
questions.answer: It is packaged with the library, merged by the consuming app, and used by ART installation/profile compilation for matching code.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
